messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's entire outfit with the top, skirt, and footwear shown in the reference images. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete target outfit, and the second shows its back view. Keep only the clothing and footwear belonging to this target outfit, and leave all non-clothing aspects of the person and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the person's whole outfit with the top, the skirt, and the footwear, as shown from the front and back in the reference images. Keep only the clothing and footwear belonging to this target outfit, and leave all non-clothing aspects unchanged. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands still in profile, then walks forward and to the right, turning her back to the camera as she moves.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body shot that keeps the character centered while she moves across the frame.","clothing":"She wears a fitted pink long-sleeve top, a short white pleated skirt, and black lace-up platform boots.","hair_color":"Reddish-brown.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled up into a high bun with loose strands framing her face.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young woman with a slim build, shown in profile and then from behind.","scene":"A futuristic outdoor plaza with a glossy reflective floor, large dark domed buildings with glowing teal and pink lights, a tall tower, and a purple vehicle in the background under a cloudy blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's colorful patterned dress and red sneakers were replaced with a fitted pink long-sleeve top, short white pleated skirt, and black lace-up platform boots. Her hair, body, walking motion, camera framing, and futuristic plaza scene remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's entire outfit with the reference outfit: pink long-sleeve top, white pleated skirt, and black lace-up platform boots, leaving non-clothing aspects unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the small dark shoulder details visible in the reference top are present in the output is not clearly resolvable.
